"'''The Jedi and the Thief / The Missing Kibbin'''" is the seventh episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[May 4]], [[2023]].<ref name="D23 May" />

==Official description==
''Kai and Zia team up. Lys teams with a bounty hunter.''
